_comment: Each provider's earliest available ghcr.io/anchore/grype-db/data/<name>:<YY-MM-DD> tag, confirmed via the GitHub Packages API package creation timestamp (not just what's currently tagged). Used only to skip dates we already know are too early; the discovery step still confirms the tag actually exists before exporting it. No provider has ever been dropped or renamed upstream (checked directly: all current providers were still updating as of 2026-11-22), so there's no removal case to represent here.
